verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Memory MCP Server allowing MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) to connect to agent memory, and a separate Graphiti MCP server for its open-source graph engine. This is well-documented first-party capability with a dedicated docs page and probe confirmation. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server working in practice.
